column4: Description

Design and implement tables/relations for every record type (Learner, Module, Lecture, Quiz, FillInTheBlankQuestion, Enrolment, Attempts, Certificate, Materials, StaffMember, Law, Tool, OptionLists, RegistrationApplication, LecturerProfile, Review, Announcement/MessageThread, AuditEntry, PlatformSettings).
Learner + staff login, 2-step verification for staff, password hashing/policies, session issuing/expiry (8h idle).

Server-side permission checks for all seven roles (super-admin, module-admin, laws-admin, tools-admin, list-manager, provincial-registrar, lecturer); the prototype's checks are UI-only and must be rebuilt for real.
CRUD for Modules, Lectures, content blocks (video/text/materials), publishing states, ordering.
Question storage, attempt submission, scoring/pass-fail logic, word-bank/blank matching for both question types.
Upload/store/list Material assets and groups, link assets to lectures.
CRUD for Law and Tool entities, province scoping for Laws, publishing states.
Dynamic option lists (Hazards, Categories, etc.) CRUD, and the tag-overlap queries that relate Modules to Laws/Tools and compute usage counts.
Submit application, province-based routing to the right Provincial Registrar, approve/reject/resubmit state machine.
Enrol in a module, track current lecture, completed lectures, quiz/blank attempt history.
Generate certificates on completion, reference numbering, withdrawal, and the public no-login lookup endpoint.
Create/suspend staff accounts, appoint roles, assign modules (lecturer/module-admin) or provinces (registrar).
Submit module/lecturer reviews, moderation queue (approve/reject), auto-flag handling.
Announcements (audience targeting), two-way message threads (valid role pairs only), notification/unread tracking.
Aggregate stats each console's dashboard needs (learners, modules, certificates, pending queues, etc.) from one trusted source, never per-screen totals.
Append-only writer + query endpoints for the action log; must be immutable at the DB level.
Single-record settings store (brand fields, registration toggle, chatbot knowledge-base text, etc.).
Real file uploads, video hosting/streaming, Law document storage/delivery (S3-style or equivalent).
Password resets, staff invitations, registration decision emails, certificate-given notices.
Replace the prototype's keyword search with a real model/RAG reading live catalogue data, with an honest fallback when it doesn't know.
Input validation, rate limiting, enforcing every permission check server-side, data retention/minimisation rules.
Hosting, environment config, CI/CD pipeline, database backups, monitoring/alerting.
